name: 21613 · Cambridge, MD
findings: ZIP 21613 (Cambridge) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21613 (Cambridge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21613 (Cambridge) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
